hero.venue: The Star Theatre, Homecoming Centre, District 6, Cape Town

intro.highlight: live theatre event and media platform where African entrepreneurs share their inspiring journeys.
intro.after: It’s not just a stage, it’s a support platform. The stories are raw, honest and deeply human. They highlight resilience, ingenuity and legacy while amplifying African entrepreneurship to the world.

origin.heading: The Origin of ORIGIN STORIES...
paragraphs: "Early one Friday morning while talking with an African entrepreneur and walking down Lion's Head mountain in Cape Town.

I realised there was nowhere to listen to or share these inspiring African entrepreneurs' stories (like Nkosinathi's) and for them to inspire the next generation of dreamers, builders and value-creators.
After reading the quote "IF NOT NOW, WHEN? IF NOT ME, WHO?" and being encouraged by others.
We decided to create this platform to showcase the most inspiring African Entrepreneur stories and share them with the World.
Join us in supporting and celebrating these inspiring Humans."
origin.authorNote: a WGW Community and Africa Tech Ecosystem initiative.

about.heading: What is
about.body:
• 7 - 10 handpicked curated speakers.

  • Each speaker has 7 minutes to share the real story behind their entrepreneurial journey.

  • Think 'TED talk' meets 'PechaKucha' with a healthy dose of humour, emotions, celebrations and support.

  • The event is NOT an investor, product, business, sales or marketing pitch.

  • An informal networking and entertaining evening with other curious and supportive Humans.

  • A global community supporting African entrepreneurs.

vision.heading: Our
vision.body:
To inspire, connect and positively shape the global narrative of African entrepreneurship.
To reach 1 million African Entrepreneurs by 2050.

This isn’t just a platform, it’s a stage for stories that resonate, ideas that linger and unheard voices to make a lasting impact.

Are you ready to experience real human and inspiring African Origin Stories?

We look forward to welcoming you on the 19th of November 2026 at 18:30 for 19:00 (doors open 18:00).

Thanks to all our partners for your support especially Silicon Overdrive, Western Cape Government and Von Seidels. Thanks to our volunteer team.

*All profits will be reinvested to host future events to create and distribute more stories and help support High School entrepreneur programmes in Africa.
